scope: Mobile keyboard step progression and read-only administrator list reconnection/session guards
verified: Implicit form submit advances steps one and two without network writes
Invalid required numeric field receives focus and cannot advance
Step heading receives focus and previous answers retained
Invalid phone receives focus without storage
Preview keyboard step progression remains analytics/write-free
Snapshot error retains displayed rows and exposes reconnect action
Cache-only snapshot is not described as current server data
Obsolete snapshot callbacks/errors ignored after reconnection
Concurrent older-page reads blocked, including live snapshot during pending read
Delayed page read ignored after logout or new login session
remainingLimitations: Admin page must remain open for existing foreground notifications; no external SMS/mail/background delivery route found
